candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `MinSum = _val;` so SetMinSum no longer updates MinSum.
Delete the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard so MinSum can be changed even after initialization.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = _val + 1;` so the stored MinSum differs from the argument.
Delete the guard `if(intitalized)revert();` so SetMinSum can overwrite MinSum after initialization, changing the observable MinSum value in later calls.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = MinSum + _val;` so the stored value accumulates instead of being assigned, changing the observable MinSum.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = _val + 1;` so the observable MinSum differs from the value passed in.
Delete the line 'LogFile = Log(_log);' so the log file address is never assigned and the getter always returns the zero address.
Delete the initialization guard so SetLogFile overwrites LogFile even after initialization.
Replace the assignment with 'LogFile = Log(address(0));' so the getter returns the zero address instead of the supplied address.
Invert the guard condition to 'if(!intitalized)revert();' so the assignment only happens after initialization, leaving LogFile at zero otherwise.
Replace `acc.balance += msg.value;` with `acc.balance = msg.value;` so the stored balance no longer accumulates across deposits.
Delete the statement `acc.balance += msg.value;` so deposited funds are never recorded in the holder's balance.
Delete the unlockTime update statement so the holder's unlock time never changes.
Change the strict comparison `>` to `>=` in the unlockTime update so equal timestamps also overwrite the unlock time.
Insert `acc.unlockTime = 0;` at the end so every Put resets the holder's unlock time to zero.
